text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Whew, looks like Mimi's OK!
But who's that girl with her?
choice_data_list: They look like such good friends.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミミが無事でよかった～
けど、
あの女の子誰かな？

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, she sure is!
Wait, that doesn't tell us anything!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね、
かわいいね～
って、
なんにもわからないままだよ～！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
If Mimi's having fun, she can't be bad!
Man, now I wanna play with them both too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミミが楽しそうだから、
悪い子じゃないよね！
ミソギも一緒に遊びたくなってきちゃった！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah. If Mimi wasn't here, she'd be all on her own.
Guess we'd better play with her!
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに、
ミミが一緒じゃなかったら
ひとりぼっちだもんね。
一緒に遊んであげなきゃ！
